text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Frederick Chiluba says Zambia will not take sides in the conflict between the Zairean government and rebels led by Laurent Kabila.
- A 40-year-old South African woman has been arrested for possession of two kilograms of high-grade cocaine.
- A witness in an electoral petition challenging Chiluba's credentials claims the president is of Mozambican parentage.
- The government says it will soon stop funding the country's two universities which must now mobilise their own resources.
- A purported cousin of President Chiluba, testifying in an electoral petition against the president, claims Chiluba was expelled from secondary school for smoking marijuana.
